content: Poetry legacy [tool.poetry] (python-poetry.org/docs/1.8/pyproject + poetry migration docs): name required in package mode (PEP 508 name), version required in package mode (PEP 440 string), description required in package mode (short description) — all plain TOML strings; dependencies under [tool.poetry.dependencies] with values like 'requests = "^2.13.0"' (quoted) or inline tables {version=...}; [[tool.poetry.source]] array-of-tables; package-mode = false optional; Poetry 2.x (released Sept 2024) supports PEP 621 [project] and DEPRECATES tool.poetry name/version/description fields (migration: tool.poetry.name -> project.name etc.); real-world poetry-core pyproject.toml uses [project] table.
